description: com.authenticself.domain.Wishlist has @Column addedAt (LocalDateTime, maps to added_at, nullable=false, insertable=false, updatable=false) and purchasedAt (LocalDateTime, nullable, maps to purchased_at, insertable+updatable=true). The Status enum values remain exactly [Active, Purchased]. All V1 column mappings (wishlistId, userId, furnitureId, category, price, status, createdAt, updatedAt) remain present with identical names.

com.authenticself.repository.WishlistRepository exists, extends JpaRepository<Wishlist, String>, and declares exactly the three methods findByUserIdAndFurnitureId(String, String), findAllByUserIdAndStatusOrderByUpdatedAtDesc(String, Wishlist.Status), and findByWishlistIdAndUserId(String, String) with the return types specified in FR-3.

Given a seeded user u1 and furniture f_desk_001, when POST /api/v1/wishlist {furnitureId:'f_desk_001',category:'desk',price:189000} with X-User-Id:u1 is called, then response is HTTP 201 with body {wishlistId:<uuid>, userId:'u1', furnitureId:'f_desk_001', category:'desk', price:189000, status:'Active', addedAt:<iso>, purchasedAt:null, alreadyExists:false}, AND a new wishlist row is persisted.

Given an existing wishlist row for (u1, f_desk_001) with status=Active, when POST /api/v1/wishlist {furnitureId:'f_desk_001',...} with X-User-Id:u1 is called again, then response is HTTP 200 with alreadyExists:true AND the same wishlistId as the existing row AND the row's addedAt/price/status are unchanged AND wishlist row count for that (userId,furnitureId) remains 1.

Given an existing wishlist row for (u1, f_desk_001) with status=Purchased, when POST /api/v1/wishlist is re-invoked for the same pair, then response is HTTP 200 with alreadyExists:true AND the returned status is 'Purchased' (NOT reset to Active). The row's purchasedAt timestamp is unchanged.
POST /api/v1/wishlist with a furnitureId that does not exist returns HTTP 404 with errorCode='FURNITURE_NOT_FOUND' and no row is inserted.
POST /api/v1/wishlist with X-User-Id referencing an unknown user returns HTTP 404 with errorCode='USER_NOT_FOUND'.
POST /api/v1/wishlist with body {category:'sofa',...} (not in {desk,bed,chair,lighting}) returns HTTP 400 with errorCode='INVALID_WISHLIST_PAYLOAD'.
POST /api/v1/wishlist with body {price:-1,...} returns HTTP 400 with errorCode='INVALID_WISHLIST_PAYLOAD'.

POST /api/v1/wishlist without the X-User-Id header returns HTTP 400 with errorCode='MISSING_USER_HEADER' and the response body conforms to the shared ErrorResponse {errorCode, message, correlationId} shape.

Two concurrent POST /api/v1/wishlist calls for the same (userId, furnitureId) resolve to exactly one persisted wishlist row (the second call sees DataIntegrityViolation on uq_wishlist_user_furniture, which the service translates to a successful 200 alreadyExists:true response).

Given a user with 2 Active and 1 Purchased wishlist rows, GET /api/v1/wishlist (no status filter) with X-User-Id returns HTTP 200 with totalActive=2, totalPurchased=1, and items ordered ACTIVE-first (both subsets internally sorted by updated_at DESC).

GET /api/v1/wishlist?status=ACTIVE returns only rows whose DB status='Active'; GET /api/v1/wishlist?status=PURCHASED returns only rows whose DB status='Purchased'. Filter matching is case-insensitive on the query value ('active', 'Active', 'ACTIVE' all accepted).
GET /api/v1/wishlist?status=PENDING returns HTTP 400 with errorCode='INVALID_WISHLIST_STATUS_FILTER' (only ACTIVE / PURCHASED accepted).

GET /api/v1/wishlist items[] each contain a furnitureSnapshot object with non-null keys name, imageUrl (nullable), colorHex, type — sourced from the current furniture row. Deleting a furniture row (FK RESTRICT prevents this for wishlisted rows, so this test uses a catalog item that was pre-seeded, wishlisted, then had its wishlist row retained across a hypothetical catalog row expiry) yields furnitureSnapshot=null while the wishlistId remains listable.

GET /api/v1/wishlist for a user u1 never returns rows whose user_id != 'u1' (no cross-user leakage). Verified by seeding rows under (u1, f_desk_001), (u2, f_desk_001) and asserting the response for X-User-Id:u1 contains exactly the u1-owned row.
When a user has more than app.wishlist.max-items-per-user (500 default) rows, GET /api/v1/wishlist returns the 500 most-recently-updated rows AND the top-level field truncated=true.

Given an Active wishlist row w1 owned by u1, PATCH /api/v1/wishlist/w1 body {status:'PURCHASED'} with X-User-Id:u1 returns HTTP 200 with status='Purchased' AND the row's purchased_at is set to a non-null timestamp within the last 5 seconds. updated_at also advances.

Given a Purchased wishlist row w1 owned by u1 (purchased_at populated), PATCH /api/v1/wishlist/w1 body {status:'ACTIVE'} with X-User-Id:u1 returns HTTP 200 with status='Active' AND purchased_at is reset to NULL.

Given an Active wishlist row w1, PATCH {status:'ACTIVE'} returns HTTP 200 AND is a no-op: purchased_at stays NULL, updated_at is NOT bumped (compared byte-for-byte to the pre-call updated_at via INFORMATION_SCHEMA or JPA re-fetch). Same assertion for Purchased→Purchased no-op.
PATCH /api/v1/wishlist/w1 body {status:'PENDING'} returns HTTP 400 with errorCode='INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION' AND the row in DB is unchanged (status, purchased_at, updated_at untouched).
PATCH /api/v1/wishlist/nonexistent returns HTTP 404 with errorCode='WISHLIST_ITEM_NOT_FOUND'. Same response when the wishlistId exists but is owned by a different user (existence is not leaked).
DELETE /api/v1/wishlist/w1 with X-User-Id=owner returns HTTP 204 with empty body AND the row is removed from the DB. Valid from both Active and Purchased states.
DELETE /api/v1/wishlist/nonexistent OR DELETE with X-User-Id != owner returns HTTP 404 with errorCode='WISHLIST_ITEM_NOT_FOUND'; DB state unchanged.

WishlistErrorCode enum contains exactly the values INVALID_WISHLIST_PAYLOAD, INVALID_WISHLIST_STATUS_FILTER, INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION, USER_NOT_FOUND, FURNITURE_NOT_FOUND, WISHLIST_ITEM_NOT_FOUND (plus the optional WISHLIST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED). Every enum value has a non-null defaultMessage and an httpStatus matching the FR-9 mapping.

WishlistExceptionAdvice is annotated @RestControllerAdvice(basePackages = "com.authenticself.wishlist") AND @Order(Ordered.HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE) AND emits ErrorResponse(errorCode.name(), message, correlationId) — identical pattern to SpaceExceptionAdvice.

WishlistService emits exactly one INFO log line per successful add / patch / delete containing the substrings op= userId= furnitureId= OR wishlistId= fromStatus= toStatus=. Error paths log WARN with errorCode= correlationId=.

application.yml contains the key app.wishlist.max-items-per-user with integer default 500. Overriding it via an environment variable WISHLIST_MAX_ITEMS_PER_USER (or Spring property override) reflects in the AC-21 truncation behaviour.

artifacts/UC-02-wishlist/api_contract.yaml exists, parses as OpenAPI 3.0.x, and defines paths /api/v1/wishlist (POST, GET), /api/v1/wishlist/{wishlistId} (PATCH, DELETE). Every non-2xx response references the shared SpringErrorResponse / ErrorResponse schema shape {errorCode, message, correlationId}. The file declares the enum WishlistStatus with exactly the two values ACTIVE and PURCHASED.

The api_contract.yaml enumerates every new error code (INVALID_WISHLIST_PAYLOAD, INVALID_WISHLIST_STATUS_FILTER, INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION, USER_NOT_FOUND, FURNITURE_NOT_FOUND, WISHLIST_ITEM_NOT_FOUND, MISSING_USER_HEADER) in the SpringErrorResponse.errorCode enum OR in a dedicated WishlistErrorCode enum schema.

src/mobile/src/api/wishlist.ts exports four async functions addToWishlist, listWishlist, patchWishlist, deleteWishlist with the signatures specified in FR-15. All four use the X-User-Id header and Accept: application/json; all four throw ApiError (from client.ts) on non-2xx responses.

In RecommendationScreen.ItemCard, tapping the '위시리스트에 추가' button (testID btn-wishlist-<furnitureId>) triggers (a) the existing analytics emit emitWishlistAddClicked({roomId, furnitureId}) AND (b) a fetch / XMLHttpRequest to POST /api/v1/wishlist with body {furnitureId:<id>, category:<item.type>, price:<item.price>} and X-User-Id header. Verified via a spy on the addToWishlist mock AND the analytics sink spy.

When addToWishlist resolves with alreadyExists:false and status='Active', the RN card shows toast '위시리스트에 담았어요.'. When alreadyExists:true and status='Active', toast is '이미 위시리스트에 있어요.'. When alreadyExists:true and status='Purchased', toast is '이미 구매 완료로 표시된 항목이에요.'. Each case verified by spying showToast / ToastAndroid.show / Alert.alert.

When addToWishlist rejects with ApiError (errorCode=FURNITURE_NOT_FOUND or USER_NOT_FOUND), the toast is '위시리스트에 추가하지 못했어요.'. Any other rejection yields '네트워크 오류로 추가하지 못했어요.'. Screen does NOT navigate away in either case (navigation.navigate / replace / push spy receives zero calls attributable to the button).

src/mobile/src/screens/WishlistScreen.tsx exists. Rendered with a mocked listWishlist returning {items:[2 Active, 1 Purchased], totalActive:2, totalPurchased:1}, the screen contains the text '내 위시리스트', two tab labels containing '보관 중 (2)' and '구매 완료 (1)'. The default tab shows only the 2 Active cards.

Each wishlist card renders furnitureSnapshot.name, '₩<toLocaleString("ko-KR")>' price string, category label from CATEGORY_LABELS (책상/침대/의자/조명), and addedAt formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'. If furnitureSnapshot is null, the card renders '원본 상품이 삭제되었습니다.' and exposes only the 삭제 action.

Tapping the '구매 완료' button on an Active card invokes Alert.alert with the confirm prompt '구매 완료로 표시할까요?'; after tapping '확인', patchWishlist is called with {wishlistId, status:'PURCHASED'} exactly once. On success, the card moves into the '구매 완료' tab (its render node now falls under testID tab-content-purchased, is absent from testID tab-content-active).
Tapping '보관 중으로 되돌리기' on a Purchased card confirms and calls patchWishlist with status='ACTIVE'; on success the card moves to the Active tab.

Tapping '삭제' on any card confirms via Alert.alert '위시리스트에서 삭제할까요?'; on confirm, deleteWishlist is called exactly once with {wishlistId} and the card disappears from both tabs (its testID is no longer present).
Empty-tab states: when totalActive=0 (mocked), the Active tab renders '아직 저장된 가구가 없어요.'; when totalPurchased=0, the Purchased tab renders '아직 구매 완료로 표시된 가구가 없어요.'.
Loading state: with a never-resolving listWishlist mock and 500 ms of fake-timer advance, the screen renders a spinner AND the text '위시리스트를 불러오는 중이에요...'.

Error state: when listWishlist rejects, the screen renders '위시리스트를 불러오지 못했어요.' and a '다시 시도' button. Tapping it invokes listWishlist a second time. A PATCH/DELETE error with errorCode=WISHLIST_ITEM_NOT_FOUND triggers a toast '이미 삭제된 항목이에요.' and calls listWishlist again (refresh) exactly once.

App.tsx RootStackParamList contains a Wishlist: undefined entry AND <Stack.Screen name="Wishlist" component={WishlistScreen} options={{title: '내 위시리스트'}}/>. The existing Recommendation route entry with type { roomId; preferredStyle? } remains byte-for-byte unchanged.

HomeScreen contains a new button with label containing '위시리스트' (testID btn-open-wishlist). Tapping it calls navigation.navigate('Wishlist') exactly once. The existing primary '방 사진 업로드' / '시작하기' button still renders and is not removed.

All prior RecommendationScreen test assertions (AC-44, AC-45, AC-46, AC-47, AC-49, AC-50 of UC-01-recommendation) still pass. In particular, the emitWishlistAddClicked analytics event still fires exactly once per button tap (UC-01-recommendation AC-48 preserved), AND no additional network calls to /wishlist occur from other code paths (only the button triggers addToWishlist).
